cover.title: 5 niche ways to become the source chatgpt quotes in europe

inner.title: publish the official page
inner.body: ahrefs found the word official in 13.1% of chatgpt's english search queries, up from 10.1%. if your own site has no page that says what you are, it quotes whoever does.

inner.title: state the plain facts
inner.body: on factual prompts, 84.4% of chatgpt answers cited an official source. put pricing, countries served and where your data lives in plain text, not in a pdf.

inner.title: open your support pages
inner.body: ahrefs says brand support pages gained citations as chatgpt moved to original sources. the answer it needs is probably sitting behind your login.

inner.title: write the price down
inner.body: price rose from 6.04% to 8.88% of chatgpt's english fan-out queries. a pricing page that says contact us gives it nothing to quote.

inner.title: stop renting your reputation
inner.body: reddit fell from about 19.1% of chatgpt answers to about 2.3%, wikipedia from 14.1% to 2.9% (us, march to september 2026). the page that spoke for you last spring is barely quoted now.
